name: Akoeman
detail: PARENT CONFLICT: BUCREP 2005 lists Akoeman under Nyong-et-Mfoumou (CM002009); OCHA COD-AB and ELECAM 2025 place it in Nyong-et-So'o (CM002010). Official P-code used; conflict recorded in issues.
resolution: Decree 2010/198 (16 June 2010), p.4: 'DEPARTEMENT DU NYONG-ET-SO'O – Arrondissement d'AKOEMAN, chef-lieu : Akoeman' (ex-District d'Akoeman, carved from Mbalmayo). BUCREP's placement under Nyong-et-Mfoumou is an error in the directory. Verified visually 2026-10-17.
